name: First Step!
source:
A high school with separate teaching of boys and girls with the border along a tall wall. One day and explosion occurs and it suddenly becomes a co-ed school. What kind of school life will they enjoy?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所高中，男女生分开教学，边界沿高墙而建。有一天，发生爆炸，它突然变成了一所男女混合学校。他们将享受怎样的学校生活？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
